fact: The UNESCO ROAM-X assessment (2025) recommends that the government draft and adopt a freedom of information law, and names an access to public information commission as an entity still to be established; it names no draft.
The UNESCO ROAM-X assessment (2025) lists an access to public information commission among the entities still to be established, so no oversight body is reported.

A report presented on 20 November 2026 by RPDH with Transparency International says Congo lacks a general access to information framework, and that only Angola in Central Africa has a general law on the subject.
